COMICCHESS-SOUL_LAMP_POWER.title: Soul Lamp
COMICCHESS-SOUL_LAMP_POWER.description: You may spend [blue]1[/blue] stack of [gold]Ignore Limits[/gold] to play [blue]1[/blue] [purple]Bound[/purple] card for free.
COMICCHESS-BINDING_OATH_POWER.title: Binding Oath
COMICCHESS-BINDING_OATH_POWER.descriptio: You may only play [blue]1[/blue] [purple]Bound[/purple] card per turn. [purple]Bound[/purple] is not removed at end of turn.
COMICCHESS-CHAINS_PRISON_POWER.title: Chains Prison
COMICCHESS-CHAINS_PRISON_POWER.descripti: When you gain [gold]Soul Lamp[/gold], the target takes {Amount} damage.
COMICCHESS-SOUL_MOLD_POWER.title: Soul Mold
COMICCHESS-SOUL_MOLD_POWER.description: The first time you play a Skill each turn, add 1 [gold]Fade[/gold] copy of it to your hand and inflict [purple]Bound[/purple] on it.
COMICCHESS-ASHEN_WALL_POWER.title: Ashen Wall
COMICCHESS-ASHEN_WALL_POWER.description: Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card with [gold]Fade[/gold], gain {Amount} [gold]Block[/gold].
COMICCHESS-HANDS_NEXT_TURN_POWER.title: Twin Hands Echo
COMICCHESS-HANDS_NEXT_TURN_POWER.descrip: At the start of your next turn, add 1 [gold]Hand of Seizure+[/gold] and 1 [gold]Hand of Refusal+[/gold] to your hand.
COMICCHESS-STRONG_ADAPTABILITY_POWER.des: At the start of your turn, choose a card in your hand to upgrade.
COMICCHESS-WILLFUL_POWER.title: Willful
COMICCHESS-WILLFUL_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, [aqua]gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Soul Lamp[/aqua].
